question: In which city was Jawaharlal Nehru born?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Allahabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru, the first Prime Minister of independent India, was born on **14 November 1889** in Allahabad.
 
• Allahabad, now known as Prayagraj, is a city in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• He was born into a wealthy and politically active family, with his father Motilal Nehru being a prominent lawyer and nationalist leader.
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru played a pivotal role in India's struggle for independence and was a central figure in Indian politics both before and after independence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru**

 
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru was an Indian independence activist and, subsequently, the first Prime Minister of India.
 
• He emerged as a prominent leader of the Indian independence movement under the tutelage of Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• Nehru's vision of India was rooted in secularism, socialism, and democracy.
 
• He is also remembered for his efforts in establishing institutes of higher learning, such as the Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs) and the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS).
 
 
 
• **Allahabad (Prayagraj)**
 
 
• Allahabad, officially known as Prayagraj, is a historic city in the state of Uttar Pradesh in India.
 
• It is one of the oldest cities in India, with a history dating back to ancient times.
 
• The city is known for its confluence of three rivers – the Ganges, the Yamuna, and the mythical Saraswati – a site called Triveni Sangam.
 
• Prayagraj is also famous for the Kumbh Mela, a mass Hindu pilgrimage held every 12 years.
 
 
 
• **Motilal Nehru**
 
 
• Motilal Nehru was an Indian lawyer, activist, and politician who was a leader of the Indian National Congress.
 
• He was a prominent figure in the Indian independence movement and the father of Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
• Motilal Nehru was an advocate of constitutional reforms and played a key role in the drafting of the Nehru Report, which outlined a proposed constitutional framework for India.
